propositions: Extend the characterization suite to pin, by exact expected value, the current output of every Jira adapter unit that the next story will move.
The existing backend contract suite is backend-agnostic and cannot detect a Jira-specific mapping regression during extraction.
Every value map must be asserted for all keys and for an unmapped key hitting the documented default ("To Do"/"Medium"), the branch most likely dropped during extraction.
Sanitizers and truncation must be pinned at, below, and above their limits, including the invalid-label raise.
classify_probe_response and map_fields_to_remote must have every branch exercised and coverage-verified, with no src/ changes in this story.
Mutation checks must prove for at least three pinned units that altering the source value turns the characterization test RED.
